info.description: Upload a PDF, EPUB, or DJVU document and receive recognized Markdown plus a structured quality report. Jobs are asynchronous: submit, poll, fetch. Resubmitting identical content is idempotent and free. Each accepted submission is billed at the `ocr` price published by `/v1/pricing`; get an API key at https://machinelibrary.ai/keys.
info.title: Machine Library Recognition API

file.description: PDF, EPUB, or DJVU, up to 100 MB. Format is detected from bytes.

languages.description: Optional comma-separated OCR language hints, e.g. "eng,deu". When omitted, the language is detected from the document body, falling back to English.

202.description: Job accepted; poll the Location header.

429.description: Active-job limit reached; wait for a job to finish.

404.description: No such job for this account.

get.description: Quality verdict, score, rejection reasons, structured extraction (sections, references), and the processing route.
